text: Description:Compiles, analyzes and formats data to provided documentation that assists internal customers in the development of engineering life cycle produces, services and processes. Verifies regulatory conformance and contractual compliance of products by checking that quality standards are met and configuration control enforced. Checks products using standard guidelines to verify regulatory conformance and contractual compliance. Maintains design documentation by using companyindustry standards. Assists with the collection of customer requirements and assists with inputs to in the web pages. Works under general supervision.
